Not pristine, but the kind of structure where you buy dips rather than sell rallies. Market headwinds are real — 65% breadth in a bearish regime means even good setups get sold. Banking is lagging the broader tape (score 24) — an extra headwind. Downside risk towards ₹479 is real. Capital preservation first. Verdict: HOLD. Own it? Let it work. Don't own it? Cleaner entries exist elsewhere. Outlook: Bearish → Mildly Bearish → Mildly Bearish.
